beats.summary: Pam makes a sale over the phone for the Michael Scott Paper Company.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Dunder Miff…Michael Scott Paper Company, this is Pam.

beats.summary: Michael and Pam argue quietly about offering free delivery to a client.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Don't tell them we have free delivery!
Pam: We already offered free delivery!

beats.summary: Michael shares a story about a peanut butter and tuna fish sandwich that was delicious in a dream but disgusting in reality.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I once had a dream. That I was eating a peanut butter and tuna fish sandwich. And, let me tell you something it was delicious.

beats.summary: Dwight and Andy debate and perform songs a cappella, with Andy claiming every song is better that way.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Literally every song is better a cappella. Name a song.

beats.summary: Michael reflects on the small size of their office but the big hearts of the people in the company.
